item.title: Massive Nepal-Tibet flood leaves hundreds dead and over 2,000 missing
item.description: Two days after severe flash flooding devastated parts of the Nepal-Tibet border, the death toll continues to rise, with nearly 2,000 people still unaccounted for.

item.title: Milo Yiannopoulos held by ICE with final removal order, sources report
item.description: Far-right commentator and deportation advocate Milo Yiannopoulos is in ICE custody, according to the agency's database.

item.title: ICE detains far-right British commentator Milo Yiannopoulos
item.description: Far-right British political commentator Milo Yiannopoulos was detained by ICE on Friday, as shown in an ICE detention database.

item.title: Watch: Partial lunar eclipse visible overnight
item.description: The moon appeared red overnight as Earth's shadow covered nearly all of its visible surface across much of North America.
